description: Arizona SNAP canonical three-person household in the package's native fact names, including values for two derived rules.
notes: Canonical values are monthly. Eight of the household facts are input slots of the admitted DES artifact; na_net_income and snap_excess_shelter_deduction_for_net_income name derived rules, which the API's package path pins only when it executes locally (see known_deviation).
This case uses the package's native slot names; the package also accepts the shared SNAP fact vocabulary (household_size, snap_gross_monthly_income, shelter_costs).

known_deviation.note: The hosted package path does not apply derived-rule pins (axiom-api#243), so the caller's na_net_income of 1442 is dropped and the engine computes net income from the other supplied facts: 1231, giving an allotment of 398.70 instead of 335.40. Expected values are the outputs with the caller's na_net_income applied, which the local executors produce. This pin records current hosted behavior so monitors alarm on change, not on the known gap.
